name: Chang Chun Eurasia Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Chang Chun Eurasia Group Co., Ltd. oversees an extensive network of supermarkets and department stores throughout China. Beyond its primary retail ventures, the company's diverse interests also encompass the tourism and digital commerce sectors. Furthermore, it delivers services related to the management of shopping complexes, the leasing of commercial properties, and broader real estate development. The enterprise is headquartered in Changchun, China.
